```{r}
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(broom)

data <- read.csv("social_media_usage_mental_health.csv")

data <- data %>%
  mutate(platform = as.factor(platform),
         country = as.factor(country))

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5, bootswatch = "darkly", primary = "#00bc8c"),
  
  titlePanel("The Digital Detox: Tracking the Cost of Connectivity"),
  
  fluidRow(
    column(12,
           wellPanel(
             h4("The Narrative"),
             p("In an era of infinite scrolling, does our time online directly impact our mental energy? 
               This dashboard explores the relationship between social media usage and mental fatigue levels. 
               By using Simple Linear Regression (SLR), we can predict how tired our brains become for 
               every extra minute we spend on our favorite apps.")
           )
    )
  ),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      h4("Interactive Controls"),
      p("Filter the story by selecting specific platforms or age groups."),
      
      selectInput("platform_filter", "Choose Platform:", 
                  choices = c("All", levels(data$platform))),
      
      sliderInput("age_filter", "Select Age Range:",
                  min = min(data$age), max = max(data$age),
                  value = c(18, 65)),
      
      hr(),
      h4("Fatigue Predictor"),
      p("Enter your daily usage to see your predicted fatigue level:"),
      numericInput("predict_input", "Daily Minutes:", value = 120, min = 0),
      actionButton("calc_btn", "Calculate Risk", class = "btn-primary")
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("The Visualization", 
                 plotlyOutput("regressionPlot", height = "500px"),
                 br(),
                 wellPanel(
                   h5("What the Data Shows"),
                   textOutput("modelSummaryText")
                 )
        ),
        tabPanel("The Model Breakdown", 
                 h4("Regression Statistics"),
                 p("For the technical audience: Here is how the numbers stack up."),
                 tableOutput("modelStats"),
                 plotOutput("residualPlot", height = "300px")
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    df <- data
    if (input$platform_filter != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(platform == input$platform_filter)
    }
    df <- df %>% filter(age >= input$age_filter[1] & age <= input$age_filter[2])
    return(df)
  })
  
  model <- reactive({
    lm(mental_fatigue_level ~ daily_usage_minutes, data = filtered_data())
  })
  
  output$regressionPlot <- renderPlotly({
    p <- ggplot(filtered_data(), aes(x = daily_usage_minutes, y = mental_fatigue_level)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#3498db") +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#e74c3c", se = TRUE) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = paste("Usage vs Fatigue (", input$platform_filter, ")"),
           x = "Daily Usage (Minutes)",
           y = "Mental Fatigue Level (1-10)")
    
    ggplotly(p)
  })
  
  output$modelSummaryText <- renderText({
    m <- model()
    coeffs <- coef(m)
    r_sq <- summary(m)$r.squared
    
    paste0("Our model suggests that for every 60 minutes of additional scrolling, your mental fatigue increases by approximately ", 
           round(coeffs[2] * 60, 2), " points. Currently, this model explains ", 
           round(r_sq * 100, 1), "% of the variation in fatigue for your selected group.")
  })
  
  output$modelStats <- renderTable({
    tidy(model())
  })
  
  output$residualPlot <- renderPlot({
    plot(model(), which = 1, col = "#00bc8c", main = "Residuals vs Fitted (Model Accuracy)")
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$calc_btn, {
    pred <- predict(model(), newdata = data.frame(daily_usage_minutes = input$predict_input))
    showModal(modalDialog(
      title = "Your Predicted Mental Fatigue",
      paste("Based on your data, spending", input$input_input, "minutes daily would result in a predicted mental fatigue level of:", round(pred, 2), "/ 10"),
      easyClose = TRUE,
      footer = NULL
    ))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
